This project has shipped fifteen wrong published figures, and every one of them
was a defect in the instrument rather than in the thing measured. So this is a
real report, not a nitpick, and it is one of the more useful ones to make.

## The claim

Quote it, and say where it is: file and line, or the page.

## What the code does

The constant, the function, or the arithmetic that decides the real value.

## The number you get

Show the working, so it can be checked without being redone.
